    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    if len(bins) == 0:
        return np.array([], dtype=float)
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    norm_rem = rem / np.maximum(max_cap, 1e-9)
    scores = np.where(valid, 1.0 - np.power(norm_rem, 0.5), -np.inf)
    log_penalty = 0.2 * np.log1p(1.0 - norm_rem)
    scores = np.where(valid & ~is_empty, scores - log_penalty, scores)
    scores = np.where(is_empty, 0.25, scores)
    return scores
